title: Enchanted Garden Post-Process Composer
description: A soldier stands guard in a mystical garden with a translucent plant and teacup. The user interactively layers and tweaks post-processing effects — bloom, depth of field, color grading, vignette, pixelation, and film grain — to transform the scene from a realistic military outpost into a dreamy, painterly fantasy tableau.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with importmap for three, three/addons, and three/examples. Load soldier.glb (with AnimationMixer playing its walk animation), DiffuseTransmissionPlant.glb placed to the soldier's left, and DiffuseTransmissionTeacup.glb placed on a small pedestal to the soldier's right. Use MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission properties on the plant and teacup so they appear translucent. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.6, 4) looking at the scene center. Add a DirectionalLight with shadows, a HemisphereLight, and a ground plane with ShadowMaterial. Use EffectComposer from postprocessing addons with RenderPass as the base. Build a GUI panel (lil-gui) with these interactive steps: (1) A checkbox to toggle UnrealBloomPass with a strength slider 0-3 (default 0.8) and threshold slider 0-1. (2) A checkbox to toggle BokehPass for depth of field with focus distance 1-10, aperture 0-0.01, and maxblur 0-0.02 sliders. (3) A checkbox to toggle ShaderPass using ColorCorrectionShader with three sliders for powRGB x, y, z each ranging 0.5-3.0. (4) A checkbox to toggle ShaderPass using VignetteShader with offset 0-2 and darkness 0-2 sliders. (5) A checkbox to toggle a custom pixelation ShaderPass with a pixelSize uniform slider 1-16. (6) A checkbox to toggle FilmPass with intensity 0-1 slider. (7) An OutputPass at the end of the chain. Each effect must validate that its parameters are within the specified ranges before applying. The GUI should group controls into labeled folders. The soldier animation should loop continuously. OrbitControls should allow camera rotation. The scene background should be a subtle gradient using a canvas texture. Ensure all passes are added to the composer in the correct order and toggled dynamically without rebuilding the chain — use the pass.enabled property. Render loop calls composer.render instead of renderer.render.
